note: Submodule of commerce_currency_resolver, requires geoip. Resolver CurrencyResolverGeoip (tag commerce_price.currency_resolver, priority 900) maps geolocated country -> currency via config commerce_currency_resolver_geoip.currency_mapping (matrix {country: code} + logic country|currency). Mapping form at /admin/commerce/config/commerce_currency_resolver/geoip, permission 'administer commerce currency resolver settings'. Config schema-only until saved. Medium reads a known matrix entry; hard writes a country mapping verified from live config. Scripts delete the mapping config to restore baseline.

evals.prompt: In Commerce Currency Resolver, what does the geoip submodule do, what module does it require, and how does it decide the currency?
evals.expected_output: It resolves currency from the visitor's geolocated country (via the contrib geoip module), looking the country up in the commerce_currency_resolver_geoip.currency_mapping matrix.

evals.prompt: The Commerce Currency Resolver geoip mapping form has a 'logic' setting. What two values can it take and what do they mean?
evals.expected_output: logic can be 'country' (assign a currency to each country) or 'currency' (assign multiple countries to each currency); both produce the same matrix (country => currency code).

evals.prompt: At what priority does the Commerce Currency Resolver geoip resolver run, and which config object stores its country-to-currency mapping?
evals.expected_output: Priority 900 (above language 800, below cookie 1000); mapping in commerce_currency_resolver_geoip.currency_mapping (matrix key).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which currency code does Commerce Currency Resolver's geoip mapping assign to the country DE (Germany)? Inspect the live configuration.

On this Drupal site, configure Commerce Currency Resolver's geoip submodule so that visitors from the United States (country code US) resolve to US Dollars (USD). Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set commerce_currency_resolver_geoip.currency_mapping matrix.US = USD (via the geoip mapping form or drush).
